Passenger timetable from Network Rail Infrastructure Limited, via DirectConnectionFinder. Station codes and names from DfT NaPTAN. Applicable bank holidays are omitted. Some stops are served on request. Wirral Line times at Lime Street Low Level and Liverpool Central, and Northern Line times at Moorfields, are estimated from published Merseytravel running times. Each estimated call is cross-checked against the passenger timetable for that service date.
